title: Benelli & CFMOTO & KOVE Zontes 350T Adventure (Enduro Spec)
description: The CFMOTO Benelli & CFMOTO & KOVE Zontes 350T Adventure (Enduro Spec) is engineered for uncompromised trans-continental exploration, positioned in the Adventure Tourer segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 350cc engine generating 44 HP and 38 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 163 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Aggressive Forward Tuck riding stance and a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
